svg.aria-label: Akilli priz breadboard yerlesimi / Smart plug breadboard layout
svg.title: Akilli priz breadboard yerlesimi / Smart plug breadboard layout
svg.text: Kartın 5V pini kullanılmaz — modüller harici 5V ile beslenir, GND ortak
The board’s 5V pin is not used — the modules run on the external 5V supply and share GND with the board.
